verdicts_or_reports.expected: After the expense 'Groceries $45' (13 Nov) is edited so its category/tag is Transport, the Categories chart should count that $45 under Transport (Food $20 from Rent, Transport $45), and the legend should show Transport.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Expense history row for 13 Nov now reads 'Purchase Reason: Transport' with $45 and 'Total: $65', but Analytics > Categories (Total range) still shows only the legend 'Food' and all $65 in Food; no Transport category appears.
steps: Start with the preconditions: Groceries $40 (Food) on 13 Nov and Rent $20 recurrent (Food); budget 100, period 11 Nov - 4 Dec.
Open the home history panel (drag the sheet up), tap the 13 November Groceries row, tap Edit.
Change the amount from 40 to 45 with the keypad and tap the check button; the row shows $45 and Total $65 (persisted after leaving and returning).
Open the history row again, tap Edit, tap the 'Transport' tag (instead of Food/Groceries), tap the check button. Row now shows 'Purchase Reason: Transport'.
Open Analytics, select the Total range, open the Categories tab.
Observe: the legend shows only 'Food' and the bar is ~$65; no Transport category exists in the chart.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After rotating to landscape, the 'Today' budget pill and the keypad fit within the screen with their amounts and key labels fully visible.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: In landscape the 'Today' pill's amount is cut off at the right edge of the pane (the pill runs under the rotated split), and the keypad's top and bottom rows (digits 7/4/1 and '0') are clipped at the pane bottom.
steps: Start with the budget at 100 and the 13 Nov expense saved (history shows $45 Transport, Total $65; Today pill shows $1.67).
Open the home history sheet and make sure the home screen is showing.
Observe: the Today pill's amount is clipped at the right edge, and the keypad rows are clipped at the bottom.
Rotate back to portrait: the layout returns and the saved expense ($45) is still present.

sign_off.notes: Filed one confirmed bug: after changing the 13 Nov expense's tag to Transport, the history row shows Transport, but Analytics > Categories (Total) still shows all $65 under Food with no Transport category. Verified without a bug: editing the amount 40 -> 45 saves and persists across leaving the screen, Total becomes $65, Analytics total, Today pill ($1.67 = 35/21) and savings card (Spent $65, Available 35%) agree; cancelling an edit ("Tap to exit" after typing 99) discards the change; the budget sheet dates (11 Nov - 4 Dec, 20 days remaining) match the preconditions. Not verified: I could not find a period start-day setting in Settings, Extra features, or the budget/new-period flow, so the 'period start day read from stored preferences' change is untested. A landscape clipping report was not reproduced by the developer. Past periods list was empty, so no past-period editing was tested. Sign-off is conditional on the untested start-day item.
